text:
anna (PM): Heads-up: ProspectBank wants tenant-owned keys + a 5-year audit lane for just audit_logs + evidence. they also want a documented emergency retention-extension (escape hatch). quick opinions?

phil (security): Feasible for pilot. must include KMS attestation, signed export manifests (sha256), and legal_hold semantics. legal needs to review before GA.

gabe (eng-infra): Tech constraints: store archival as cold blobs; keep a tiny metadata index for export lookups only. full search over 5y is out for pilot. API sketch: PATCH /v1/tenants/:id/retention {"tier":"archival","scopes":["audit_logs","evidence"]} (support-only).

maria (ops): Escape-hatch flow: support ticket + customer-signed approval hash + SRE approval -> temporary extension <=30 days -> auto-revert. ops will log the approval hash and require 2FA for approvals.

leah (sales): ProspectBank prefers a Console toggle but will accept pilot if we provide procurement one-pager and a 12-month price cap option. they want export SLA.

ops-bot: onboarding job queued: tenant ProspectBank (BYOK) job#12011 status: pending manual review.

anna (PM): Proposed pilot MVP: manual BYOK onboarding, support-only retention flips (<=30d), exportable evidence bundles with signed manifest + sha256, onboarding fee + per-GB/month archival billing, optional 12-month cap by contract. Gates: attestation checklist, legal signoff, ops runbook, cost estimate.

phil (security): Gate note: no BYOK GA until HSM attestation and legal review complete. export SLO for pilot = 48h.

gabe (eng-infra): I'll deliver a storage cost estimate and a stub CLI for export by EOW. example command:
./redwood export --tenant PBK --scope evidence --from 2020-01-01 --to 2025-01-01 --out pbk-evidence.tar.gz

maria (ops): Runbook items: verify-keystore-ownership, capture approval hash, run export job, validate checksums, deliver bundle, on-call steps. Draft due Wed.

leah (sales): I'll draft the procurement one-pager once PM posts manifest template.

anna (PM): Action items assigned. timeline: Q2 pilot (support-only), Q3 GA target (self-serve + billing integration) if gates pass. Thanks.
